patterns.usage_note: The ordinary copula, whose forms include plain だ, polite です, prenominal な, past だっ(た)/でし(た), and the linking form で that joins a noun predicate to whatever follows. Use で to chain a noun or particle phrase onto a following clause where English would say "and"; it attaches to nouns and to particle phrases (三時までで, 大阪からで). Its analytic sibling である/でもある (l2_id 3211) spells the copula out as で + ある (linking form であり) and optionally wedges in a focus particle, which raises the register or adds は/も contrast. Do not confuse it with the identical-looking clause connective で of the 順接-確定-テ類 family: that one is the te-form joint and supplies a relation between the events (sequence, or cause — 風邪で休んだ), whereas the copula's で only says 'X is such-and-such, and …' and leaves the two predications side by side.

examples.ruby: 兄[あに]は医者[いしゃ]で、僕[ぼく]は同[おな]じ道[みち]を選[えら]ばなかった。
examples.english: My brother is a doctor, and I chose not to follow the same path.

examples.ruby: 今朝[けさ]の雨[あめ]は昼[ひる]までで、午後[ごご]はきれいに晴[は]れた。
examples.english: This morning's rain lasted only until noon, and the afternoon cleared up beautifully.

examples.ruby: 今日[きょう]は休[やす]みで、朝[あさ]からずっと家[いえ]にいます。
examples.english: Today's my day off, and I've been home since morning.

patterns.usage_note: The copula spelled out as で + ある, optionally with a focus particle wedged in: である is the neutral written/expository copula, でもある adds "is also, is at the same time," ではある concedes ("it is X, but…"), and でさえある/ですらある push to "is even X." Choose it over plain だ (l2_id 3201) when you want essay or documentary register, or when the focus particle is doing real work; である is normal in writing but sounds declamatory in casual speech.

examples.ruby: 父[ちち]は数学[すうがく]の先生[せんせい]であり、サッカーチームのコーチでもある。
examples.english: My father is a math teacher, and the coach of a soccer team as well.

examples.ruby: 小[ちい]さな店[みせ]ではあるが、パンの味[あじ]は町[まち]で一番[いちばん]だ。
examples.english: It is a tiny shop, granted, but its bread is the best in town.

examples.ruby: 妹[いもうと]は家族[かぞく]でもあり、一番[いちばん]仲[なか]のいい友[とも]だちでもある。
examples.english: My little sister is family, and my closest friend besides.
